title: 「Prior to ...」表達「在……之前」

omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: Prior to + noun / noun phrase / V-ing, + main clause

formulas.formula: Prior to + noun / noun phrase, + main clause
Prior to + V-ing phrase, + main clause
Main clause + prior to + noun phrase / V-ing phrase

example: Prior to the launch, the system was tested several times.
exampleZh: 在推出之前，系統已被測試了好幾次。

examples.en: Prior to the launch, the system was tested several times.
examples.zh: 在推出之前，系統已被測試了好幾次。
examples.highlight: Prior to the launch, the system was tested several times.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：Prior to + noun / noun phrase / V-ing, + main clause。

rules.zh: Prior to 後面接名詞或名詞詞組 （在會議之前，我們核對了報告。）
rules.en: Use a noun or noun phrase after prior to: prior to the meeting; prior to the launch; prior to the arrival of the guests. Example: Prior to the meeting, we checked the report.
examples: prior to the arrival of the guests
Prior to the meeting, we checked the report.

rules.zh: Prior to 後面也可以接 verb-ing 這裏的 to 是介詞，因此後面的動詞要使用 -ing，不能使用原形動詞。
rules.en: Prior to may also be followed by a verb in the -ing form. The to here is a preposition, so use -ing rather than the base form: prior to leaving ✓; prior to using the machine ✓; prior to leave ✗; prior to use the machine ✗.

rules.zh: Prior to 後面不能直接接完整句子 應改為：
rules.en: Do not put a complete clause directly after prior to. Incorrect: Prior to we left, ...; Prior to the guests arrived, .... Rewrite it with an -ing form or noun phrase: Prior to leaving, ...; Prior to the guests’ arrival, ....

rules.zh: 使用 verb-ing 時，要注意動作執行者 在這句中，進入實驗室和戴上護目鏡的人都是 the visitors。 如果兩個動作由不同的人執行，通常應改用名詞詞組：
rules.en: When using prior to + verb-ing, make sure the implied doer of the -ing action is normally the subject of the main clause. In “Prior to entering the laboratory, the visitors put on safety glasses”, the visitors both enter and put on the glasses. If the two actions have different doers, use a noun phrase instead: Before the guests arrived, Maya prepared the living room. → Prior to the guests’ arrival, Maya prepared the living room.
examples: Prior to entering the laboratory, the visitors put on safety glasses.
Before the guests arrived, Maya prepared the living room.
→ Prior to the guests’ arrival, Maya prepared the living room.

rules.zh: 放在句首時，後面通常使用逗號 放在句末時，通常不需要逗號：
rules.en: When a prior to phrase comes first, normally put a comma after it: Prior to the interview, Marcus prepared several answers. When it comes at the end, a comma is normally unnecessary: Marcus prepared several answers prior to the interview.
examples: Prior to the interview, Marcus prepared several answers.
Marcus prepared several answers prior to the interview.

rules.zh: Prior to 比 before 較正式 Prior to 常見於： ● 報告和商業文件； ● 工作程序； ● 安全指引； ● 正式通知； ● 學術或行政寫作。 在一般日常對話中，before 往往更簡單自然。因此，prior to 並非在所有情況下都比 before 更好。
rules.en: Prior to is more formal than before. It is common in reports, business documents, workplace procedures, safety instructions, formal notices, and academic or administrative writing. In ordinary conversation, before is often simpler and more natural, so prior to is not better in every context.

benefits.zh: 清楚顯示事情的先後次序 這個句型能直接告訴讀者，某件事在另一件事之前發生。 （在檢查之前，機器已被關掉。）
benefits.en: It makes the order of events clear. The structure directly tells the reader that one event happened before another. Example: Prior to the inspection, the machine was switched off.

benefits.zh: 適合正式場合 你可以在報告、通知、工作程序和安全指引中使用 prior to，使語氣更配合正式情境。 （請在領取門票前登記。）
benefits.en: It suits formal contexts. You can use prior to in reports, notices, workplace procedures and safety instructions to match a formal setting. Example: Please register prior to collecting your ticket.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 before 如果文章中多次出現 before，可以適量使用 prior to，增加句式變化。
benefits.en: It avoids repeating before. If before appears repeatedly in a text, use prior to selectively for sentence variety. Example: Before the meeting, we checked the figures. → Prior to the meeting, we checked the figures.

benefits.zh: 令句子更流暢 當兩個動作由同一人執行時，可以把 before + subject + verb 改為 prior to + verb-ing。 這樣可以避免重複使用 Sarah 和 she。
benefits.en: It can make a sentence smoother. When the same person performs both actions, a before + subject + verb clause can become prior to + verb-ing: Before Sarah answered the email, she checked the details. → Prior to answering the email, Sarah checked the details. This avoids repeating Sarah and she.

benefits.zh: 幫助組織指示和程序 你可以用 prior to 說明某個步驟必須先完成，尤其適合工作程序和安全規則。 （進行任何維修前，請拔掉機器的電源。）
benefits.en: It helps organise instructions and procedures by showing which step must be completed first, especially in workplace processes and safety rules. Example: Prior to carrying out any repairs, unplug the machine.
